configProperties.//: RAM ceiling. Server GC (set in the csproj) is fast but lazy about releasing memory, so on a big index it can grow the working set toward all physical RAM. These bound it: HeapHardLimitPercent caps the GC heap at a % of total physical memory (the runtime collects harder as it nears the cap instead of climbing to 100%); ConserveMemory (0-9) trades a little throughput to decommit + compact so memory is handed back to the OS. Power users can override at launch with the env vars DOTNET_GCHeapHardLimitPercent (hex, e.g. 0x32 = 50) and DOTNET_GCConserveMemory (0-9).
